method: Maximize the equal-site mean of sqrt(curtailment_fraction * net_power_deficit_fraction). Curtailment_fraction = sum(surplus)/sum(wind+PV); net_power_deficit_fraction = sum(max(process_load-wind-PV,0))/sum(process_load).
time_basis: Original hourly input order; no local-time shift. Three sites use the same 168 hours.
interpretation: Purposively selected illustrative week with simultaneous surplus and deficit periods. Not an estimate of annual-average conditions or a time-resolved static comparison.
